attributes.description: The company that on 31 March 2026 accidentally uploaded 512,000 lines of Claude Code source code to the npm registry.
A dependency of swift/qwen3-asr.
The inference/quantisation runtime behind faster-whisper-large-v3, giving int8 quantisation and 4x speedup.
The product whose 512,000 lines of source code were uploaded to the npm registry on 31 March 2026.
The speech encoder architecture used by the NVIDIA Canary, Parakeet and Nemotron models.
The generative modelling method used as the architecture of F5-TTS.
The current president and CEO of Y Combinator, who argues the productivity secret is not the model but the wrapper around it, which he calls the harness.
The evaluation leaderboard on which parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2 is reported first for English.
The language-model backbone that chatterbox is built on.
The Apple Silicon framework that the mlx-community Parakeet variant is converted to.
A dependency of swift/qwen3-asr.
The speech-to-text component of mlx-audio-swift through which swift/qwen3-asr invokes Qwen3-ASR.
The voice-activity-detection library inside mlx-audio-swift that swift/vad-swift uses.
The LLM used as the language backend inside canary-qwen-2.5b.
A 1.7B multimodal ASR model derived from Qwen3-Omni, covering 30 languages plus 22 Chinese dialects.
The backbone language model of VibeVoice-Realtime-0.5B.
The backbone language model of VibeVoice-1.5B.
The speech recognition model that swift/qwen3-asr calls through MLXAudioSTT.
The multimodal base model that Qwen3-ASR-1.7B is derived from.
A 0.5B MIT-licensed TTS model with a Llama backbone plus codec, offering emotion-exaggeration control and watermarking.
A 0.3B Flow Matching zero-shot cloning model for Chinese and English, associated with the Emilia dataset and licensed cc-by-nc-4.0.
The Silero VAD v5 voice-activity-detection model embedded as a resource in the swift/vadd package.
The company where Steve Yegge currently serves as engineering lead.
A programmer well known in US developer circles who currently serves as engineering lead at Sourcegraph and is the origin of the 10x-to-1000x productivity claim.
The TTS architecture that Kokoro-82M is derived from.
A 1.55B-parameter CTranslate2-quantised Whisper build noted as the most widely deployed variant.
A speech synthesis architecture used as the backbone of XTTS-v2.
The ASR model family that distil-large-v3 is distilled from.
The organization whose sitting president and chief executive officer is Garry Tan.
A ~880M-parameter multilingual zero-shot voice cloning model built on a VITS + GPT-style architecture.
A 756M-parameter distillation of Whisper that runs on transformers and stays within 1% WER of large-v3.
An 82M-parameter English TTS model derived from StyleTTS2, released under apache-2.0 with 13.7M downloads.
A 1.5B MIT-licensed TTS model built on Qwen2.5-1.5B with a sigma-VAE, able to generate 90 minutes of audio with 4 speakers.
A 0.5B streaming TTS model built on Qwen2.5-0.5B with a 7.5Hz tokenizer, achieving ~300ms latency under an MIT license.
A 4B autoregressive causal-audio-encoder model served with vllm for sub-500ms streaming on device.
A Swift audio library that provides the MLXAudioVAD and MLXAudioSTT components.
The MLX-converted 0.6B Parakeet build optimised for Apple Silicon.
The library used to run the NVIDIA Parakeet, Canary and Nemotron speech models.
A 1B FastConformer model on nemo covering 25 EU languages for joint ASR and translation.
A 2.5B model combining FastConformer with a Qwen LLM backend supporting hotwords and context.
A 0.6B FastConformer-TDT model on the nemo library, ranked first in English on the HF ASR Leaderboard.
A 1.55B-parameter Transformer encoder-decoder ASR model run with the transformers library under apache-2.0.
A 1B decoder-only audio model for conversational English speech, run through the transformers library.
A ~1B GPT-style multilingual TTS model run through the transformers library that can produce music and laughter.
A Swift speech-recognition repository that has no independent Tests directory.
A Swift repository for voice activity detection that has no independent Tests directory.
A Swift repository whose Tests/VADKitTests directory holds four test suites and which embeds a real Silero VAD model.
The library used to run bark, csm-1b, and both VibeVoice models.
The serving library listed for Voxtral-Mini-4B-Realtime-2602.
